calm i think? like settled. its weird i dont usually feel this. honestly half expected this thing to just spit out some generic therapy line lol

bit of both maybe. ok so theres this. me and my friend mara had this weird cold patch for like months, didnt even know why. anyway she texted today out of nowhere. we just talked for an hour like nothing happened
That sounds like a shift from cold and confusing into something softer, maybe relieved and a bit surprised. Does it feel more like warmth, easing, or just the quiet after it?

the quiet after yeah. i think i didnt realize how much i was carrying it til it just. wasnt there anymore. like i kept the phone face down for months bc seeing her name made my stomach drop. didnt even tell anyone we werent talking

suddenly light. thats it exactly. huh. ok i wasnt expecting this app to actually land that. i kinda thought it'd be cheesy

nah i think im good. gonna just sit with the light for a bit. thanks tho, genuinely. didnt expect that
